content:
Eli: Heads-upwe promoted strict fncall validation to 30% in ap-south and console shows a spike of `fncall.validator.rejects` with almost zero usable samples.
Tanya: metric names? any redacted example?
Eli: `fncall.validator.rejects.v4`, `toolhook.parse_errors.v2`. Example: {"acct":"***","tool":"invoice_gen","input": [ ... array where object expected ... ] }
Omar: Was coercion on for canary?
Eli: No coercion. Bumped from 10% -> 30% this morning.
Tanya: Two immediate issues: sampling is biased (favoring small requests) and billing semantics confuse customers. Right now validation fails increment route invocation counts which customers see against their quota.
Omar: Can we temporarily increase sampling for `fncall.validator.rejects.v4` to 10% and capture a compact sample (meta + first 4KB) for large payloads?
Tanya: Also add a per-route flag `charge_on_validation_error` default true. Emit telemetry `validation.charge.attempted` and `validation.charge.waived` with route_id + reason. Only store payload samples when `waived`.
Eli: UX: Console should show "Validation billing" column in Routes and a quick link from reject histogram to the sample explorer (pre-redacted).
Omar: For safety revert strict back to 10% until sampling and console changes land. Also add `soft_validate=true` option that returns warnings instead of hard rejects for clients.
telemetry-bot: sampler-bump job started for metric fncall.validator.rejects.v4 (job 7123).
Tanya: Action items:
- Omar: revert canary -> 10% and implement `soft_validate` in API (ASAP).
- Tanya: wire telemetry metrics and compact sampling (48h).
- Eli: add Console reject-reason histogram + route toggle in Routes table (5d).
Eli: If spike persists after revert we open a postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
